guidance.text: Heat-resistant technical components requiring stiffness and mechanical durability.
Pure PC is moisture-sensitive; modified grades can behave differently.

PC blends are not equivalent to pure PC. Do not transfer a blend profile to another formulation.

summary.text: PC-CF is carbon-fibre-filled polycarbonate. Makers sell it for rigid functional parts and structural components needing heat resistance and dimensional stability. It is amorphous as printed, so it softens at its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 119⁠–⁠140 °C. On the H2C it prints at 275⁠–⁠290 °C, most products need a hardened nozzle, and some ask for bed or chamber heat beyond the H2C's limits.
